title: Proto Secure
tagline: Pause exploited Contract and cut losses for protocols for across chains
description: With every new protocol launching on every chain, it faces a threat of getting hacked and losing funds of itself and also the community. We don't think there is a way to completely hackproof contracts but we can sure prevent and cut losses. We build a monitoring platform to pause the contracts so that the hack can be prevented on different chains and the claim can be verified.
how_its_made:
We used the open zepplin pause function to pause the smart contracts after certain parameters are met. We are Curvegrid to get the logs for all the event generated by the contract. We have verified all our contracts on blockScout. we have used the Nillion Storage APIs to encrypt and store the notes mentioned by hacker to be only shared with the protocol.

We believe this project will be a public good and can potentially save billions of dollars of user funds in the future. We did manage to integrate this contract on more than 10 chains which can use our functionality from today itself
